basics.name: Brian Bagdasarian
basics.headline: Leading the Platform & AI Infrastructure Powering Your Success

summary.name: Summary
summary.content:
I lead teams in highly scalable systems design, internal platform construction and order-of-magnitude process improvements by bringing together the right people, right tools and right information to create effective solutions.

I am seeking a strategic leadership role where I can make a long-term impact with an organization committed to building best-in-class foundations.

items.summary:
M.B.A., Technology Innovation & Leadership Development

  • Leadership: Vice President of Tech Skills, Technology Business Association; Easton Fellow, Easton Technology Management Center

  • Membership: Energy & Cleantech Association, Entrepreneur Association, John Anderson Golf Club

items.institution: New York University Gallatin School of Individualized Study
items.summary:
B.A., Data Driven Decision Making; Joint Minor, Computer Science & Mathematics

  • Leadership: Host & Producer, The Cheap Seats, sports talk radio on WNYU 89.1 FM

• Delivered a 0-to-1 enterprise MVP, establishing a secure foundation built on Rust, TypeScript, and Pulumi to meet strict security requirements and support enterprise-scale deployment on day one

  • Pioneered a spec-driven agentic AI development process, optimizing context windows and model selection to accelerate feature execution and ship the full MVP on $20/month in agent spend

  • Decided key technical tradeoﬀs, replacing complex but valuable tooling with lightweight, language-native tools to maximize development velocity and guarantee deterministic deployments instead of ensuring maximum workflow extensibility

• Trained multiple teams of L4/5 engineers (12+ people) on best practices in real time data engineering on Databricks, cutting cost in half even with 10x more data, saving over $1.8m in annual cloud spend at petabyte scale

  • Project lead on enhanced developer platform in collaboration with all development teams, meeting company goals of a 10x increase in production deployment frequency, shipping new features and fixes to customers in hours, not weeks

  • Analyzed data from continuous profiling, identifying sources of instability in business-critical services to improve reliability, decreasing alerts and critical incidents by 80%, eliminating the need for $500k in additional support costs

  • Created roadmap for next-generation data delivery platform, designed to scale from petabytes to tens of petabytes, by working with product, sales, customer service and other engineers

  • Key technologies: Go, Python, Scala, SQL, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks, Redpanda, Apache Pinot, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Pyroscope, Prometheus, Grafana, AWS, Terraform, Bazel

items.position: Lead Platform Engineer | Acting Engineering Manager, Data
items.summary:
• Founding member of Cosm's Platform Team, dedicated to improving developer experience, reliability and performance of core systems, ensuring fast iteration cycles while growing the engineering team from 10 to 75+ members

  • Managed Data team as product and engineering manager, planning and delivering a multi-year roadmap, creating insight into Cosm’s first party ticketing platform and third-party data, building a culture of data-driven decision making

  • Led cross functional strategic effort across 6 departments and 30+ people to utilize our unified data platform of transaction, operational and behavioral data in everyday decisions to assist growing Cosm Venues to a $100m business

  • Mentored engineers in Cosm's internship program, training and converting interns to full-time engineers at the conclusion of the program, creating standard procedures for a robust engineering talent pipeline

  • Supported Product and Marketing teams using real time customer data on Databricks during Cosm’s multi-stage launch at less than $100 per month, culminating in sold-out launch events attended by thousands of customers with extreme efficiency

  • Designed and implemented custom infrastructure as code framework with Pulumi and TypeScript to satisfy the need for quick, precise rollouts of foundational software components

  • Drove CPRA & GDPR privacy compliance across website, mobile and backend, leading engagement with our external partners, including Databricks, Transcend & PostHog

  • Key technologies: TypeScript, Go, Rust, Scala, SQL, AWS, Kubernetes, Cilium, Flux, Pulumi, GitHub Actions, Redpanda, Debezium, Strimzi, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks, Temporal, S3, MongoDB, Prometheus, Grafana, Tailscale, Transcend

• Designed a Data Lakehouse in collaboration with stakeholders using Medallion Architecture to centralize, govern and deliver Cosm's disparate venue and business data

  • Built Cosm's network and Kubernetes infrastructure, collaborating with multiple teams including Field Engineering and Corporate IT. Responsible for integration of EKS and supporting tools, notably Cilium and Flux

  • Integrated real time change data capture for rapid analysis of customer behavior during Cosm’s multi-stage launch, supporting product manager understanding of interest & engagement within a new industry

  • Hackathon winner, "Digistar Data Cloud," multidimensional search for billions of stars across dozens of catalogs

  • Key technologies: TypeScript, Go, Rust, Scala, SQL, AWS, Kubernetes, Cilium, Flux, Pulumi, GitHub Actions, Postgres, Redpanda, Debezium, Strimzi, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks, S3, MongoDB, Prometheus, Grafana, Tailscale

• Identified need for streaming data architecture to reduce latency by analyzing product SLA and discussing customer needs with product and support, reduced overall cost 20% ($200k+ annually), even with 100% increase in data volume

  • Boosted machine learning and artificial intelligence training performance 40% by optimizing data science workflow for Databricks platform, collaborating with practitioners to reduce time to market for AI products by 50%

  • Optimized queries on 140+ TB data warehouse, increasing typical query performance 20% and reducing cost 40%, saving $400k annually

  • Automated internal billing workflow, reducing time to invoice customers from 5 days to hours

  • Key technologies: Scala, SQL, AWS, Terraform, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks, Apache Kafka, Play Framework, Docker, Snowflake, S3, Microsoft SQL Server

• Designed and built a shared services data platform, greatly increasing the speed at which new acquisitions could be onboarded, a critical metric of restoring companies to profitability

  • Planned and executed retail software platform migration across 800+ locations, including point of sale and employee authentication, resulting in an 80% decrease in day to day management tasks compared to the previous solution

  • Key technologies: Scala, SQL, NodeJS + JavaScript (ES6), Go, AWS, DigitalOcean, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Apache Spark, Snowflake, MariaDB + MyRocks, S3

• Architected and built FIJI Water's first automated data pipeline and business intelligence platform, saving 600+ hours each week on ad hoc depletions reporting and competitive set analysis

  • Led trainings for the nationwide sales team of 120+ members, focused on productive self service business intelligence, allowing representatives on demand access to verified reports and analysis across desktop and mobile environments

  • Key technologies: Scala, SQL, Azure Blob Storage, Apache Spark, Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI

• Created iOS app deployment pipeline using Git, Jenkins, and TestFlight, increasing the pace of the QA feedback loop from days to hours

  • Developed microservice utilizing Scala, Akka and MySQL for collection and analysis of Mailgun email campaign response data, giving the business insight into new user acquisition costs

  • Key technologies: Scala, MySQL, Jenkins, TestFlight

items.name: Builder Kit
items.summary: kit is an opinionated starter kit for software development, based on the Nix ecosystem. It automatically (and safely) installs and manages a fleet of coding tools, including agent harnesses, command line tools and runtimes so you can build faster and with more confidence. It powers the Easton Center's workshops, hackathons and competitions.

items.name: Tech Foundations
items.summary: Developing & delivering multi-session curriculum focused on building deeper understanding of today's technology without a tech background. Focusing on compute, networking & storage primitives, software delivery, data fundamentals & workflow automation with (and without) AI.

items.name: Pulumi, Turbocharged
items.summary: Internal Product & Engineering Lead. Fully modular, component-based infrastructure-as-code in TypeScript. Innovative architecture adopted as best practice by Pulumi itself.

items.name: Cloud Native Delivery
items.summary: Compute Infrastructure & Developer Experience lead for multiple orgs. Built reliable autoscaling & remote developer platforms on Kubernetes, designed Git workflows to move code from local to production without downtime, supported on call rotations with Prometheus and Grafana infrastructure.

items.name: Cost Effective Streaming Data
items.summary: Refined incremental streaming architecture over years of engineering experience. Now implemented at multiple orgs, including leading engagements with external partners and internal education programs.

items.name: Deterministic Environment-as-Code
items.summary: Led Nix & Bazel adoption within multiple orgs. Entire macOS/Linux environments controlled via code. No more "works on my machine" or multiple layers of virtualization. One command rebuilds my environment exactly as defined.
